items.title: 21.12 Atmospheric circulation and atmospheric cells (hawa ka ghoomna aur hawa ke cells) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of atmospheric circulation and cells (PDF 181-182).

blocks.text: Angular momentum ka conservation (yani kul angular momentum ka wahi rehna) chalti hawa ke patterns banane mein aham kirdar ada karta hai. Atmospheric circulation (hawa ka bare paimane par ghoomna) par angular momentum ke conservation aur zameen ke ghoomne ka gehra asar hota hai. Zameen ke rotation axis (ghoomne ki line) ke gird hawa ke aik hisse (air mass) ka angular momentum L = mvr hai, jahan m hawa ki mass, r axis se us ka faasla aur v us ki velocity hai. Atmospheric science mein aam taur par specific angular momentum lete hain, yani har kilogram (unit mass) ka angular momentum:

Jab hawa equator se poles ki taraf (ya ulta) chalti hai to woh apni shuru wali latitude ka specific angular momentum saath rakhti hai. Pole ki taraf jate hue axis se faasla r kam hota hai, is liye rv barabar rakhne ke liye v (east ki taraf speed) barh jati hai. Zameen ki surface equator par zyada tezi se (east, yani mashriq ki taraf) chalti hai aur oonchi latitudes par aahista. Is liye equator se pole ki taraf jane wali hawa neeche ki zameen se tez east ki taraf chalti hai aur aage nikal jati hai; zameen se dekhne par yeh east ki taraf murti nazar aati hai, jo northern hemisphere mein us ki movement ke daen (right) taraf hai. Pole se equator ki taraf jane wali hawa ulta karti hai: tez chalti zameen se peeche reh jati hai aur west (maghrib) ki taraf murti hai, jo phir bhi northern hemisphere mein us ki daen taraf hai. Zameen ke ghoomne se chalti hawa ka yeh apparent (sirf nazar aane wala) murna Coriolis effect kehlata hai. Murna northern hemisphere mein daen aur southern hemisphere mein baen (left) taraf hota hai. Yeh hawa ki speed nahi badalta, sirf us ka raasta badalta hai, jis se hawa ke mure hue patterns bante hain. In mure hue hawa ke bahaon se har hemisphere mein hawa ki circulation ke teen alag cells bante hain: Hadley cell, Ferrel cell aur Polar cell. In cells ka diagram Fig. 21.14 mein hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke equator se pole ki taraf jane wali hawa 'neeche ki surface ke ghoomne se peeche reh jati hai' (lags behind). Kitab ki apni daleel se (r kam, is liye v zyada) yeh hawa neeche ki zameen se tez east ki taraf chalti hai, is liye aage nikal kar east (northern hemisphere mein daen) ki taraf murti hai. Peeche woh hawa reh jati hai jo pole se equator ki taraf aati hai. Dono suraton mein northern hemisphere mein murna daen taraf hi hai.

blocks.alt: Zameen ka gola, beech mein equator. Northern hemisphere mein pole ki taraf aur equator ki taraf chalti hawa ke arrows daen taraf mur jate hain; southern hemisphere mein baen taraf. Grey dashed arrows seedha raasta, neele arrows asal mura hua raasta. Oopar arrow: zameen west se east ghoomti hai.
blocks.caption: Coriolis effect: north mein daen aur south mein baen taraf murna (hamari izafi drawing; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chalti hawa apni speed nahi badalti, sirf us ki direction murti hai. Northern hemisphere mein hawa jis taraf bhi chale, apni daen taraf murti hai; southern hemisphere mein baen taraf. Isi se trade winds, westerlies aur polar easterlies tirchi chalti hain.

blocks.alt: Globe par latitudes 60, 30, 0, 30, 60 degree. Is ke gird dono taraf aur dono hemispheres mein arrows ke band chakkar: laal arrows surface ke qareeb aur uthti hawa, neele arrows oonchai par aur baithti hawa. Labels: equator par Hadley Cells, 30 aur 60 degree ke darmiyan Ferrel Cell (chaar baar), oopar neeche Polar Cell.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.14: zameen ki atmospheric circulation mein cells banne ka diagram (kitab ki Figure 21.14 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hadley cell mein garam hawa equator par uth kar oonchai par poles ki taraf jati hai aur 30 degree latitude ke qareeb neeche baithti hai. Polar cell mein thandi hawa poles par baith kar 60 degree ke qareeb uthti hai. Ferrel cell in dono ke darmiyan (30 se 60 degree) hai. Surface ke qareeb wapas aane wali hawa Coriolis effect se mur kar trade winds, westerlies aur polar easterlies banti hai.

blocks.prompt: Southern hemisphere mein chalti hawa kis taraf murti hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Apni movement ke baen (left) taraf, zameen ke ghoomne ki wajah se (Coriolis effect, jo angular momentum ke conservation se samajh aata hai). Northern hemisphere mein daen taraf murti hai.

items: Chalti hawa specific angular momentum L = rv (21.6) wahi rakhti hai.
Coriolis effect: northern mein daen, southern mein baen murna; speed wahi rehti hai.
Har hemisphere mein teen cells: Hadley (0-30 degree), Ferrel (30-60), Polar (60-90).
